prompt: You text a funny picture to 2 friends, and every person who gets it sends it to 2 new people. After 10 rounds, the round reaches $2^{10}$ people. How many people is that?
hint: Multiplying ten $2$s one at a time is slow. Look for a way to split the power into two equal pieces you already know.

hints.text: Multiplying ten $2$s one at a time is slow. Look for a way to split the power into two equal pieces you already know.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Count one round at a time: round $1$ reaches $2$ people, round $2$ reaches $4$, round $3$ reaches $8$. Each round DOUBLES.
Because $5 + 5 = 10$, the product rule gives $2^{10} = 2^5 \times 2^5$, and $2^5 = 32$. Work out $32 \times 32$.
$32 \times 32 = 1024$, so the picture reaches $1024$ people in round ten.

explanation: Each round doubles the number of people reached, so round ten reaches $2^{10}$ people.
Split the power with the product rule: $2^{10} = 2^5 \cdot 2^5$, because the exponents $5 + 5$ add to $10$.
Since $2^5 = 32$, the answer is $32 \times 32 = 1024$ people reached in round ten.

alternativeExplanations.title: Keep doubling a list
steps: The 10th number in the doubling list is 1024.
